review.feedback: English draft resting on a snapshot of the quality-trend effectiveness labels at Demerzel commit 4b03838800dcd4894f1e026461979bff1d985ca8 (1,529 pairs of consecutive labelled rows, 1 changed) and on a deterministic analysis whose 30 self-checks pass. The six forecasters it scores are imaginary, none was issued before the outcomes, and two of them use hindsight; the proper-scoring section is synthetic. The draft concludes that on this record the Brier score ranks the three leading forecasters on the strength of one pair. Human subject review, learner trial and publication remain pending; the French and Spanish translations have had no native-speaker review.
